rounds.text: RDB Infrastructure and Power Ltd is trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic valuation, with a discounted cash flow model placing intrinsic value at Rs 24 per share against a market price of ₹ 16.2, offering a substantial margin of safety of 31.9% [E2, E44, E45]. The company's growth metrics heavily outpace its valuation and price performance, demonstrated by a stellar 62% compounded profit growth rate over five years and a massive 126% profit growth over the trailing twelve months, whilst the stock has languished with a 12-month return of -68% [E19, E21, E25, E55]. This creates a fundamental disconnect where earnings growth dramatically exceeds 1-year price growth by 194% [E56]. Furthermore, the balance sheet has been aggressively strengthened as borrowings plummeted from Rs 77 Cr to Rs 21 Cr, resulting in a conservatively financed debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.08x and positioning the company as almost debt-free [E38, E39, E59]. Institutional interest is also creeping in with foreign institutions increasing their stake to 2.06% from 0.00% [E42]. Conceded: operating cash flow is negative at Rs -66 Cr for March 2026 and the 1-year share price return stands at -68% [E25, E35].
